//webDir: webDir = public/<tree> — THE OUTPUT FOLDER, written by the build (internal/sync-app-shells.mjs keeps it
in step with the tree's name in vite.doxa-maps-build-config.json; do not edit it by hand).
public/ holds ONLY the output folder + README.md (decision BUILD-OUTPUT-IS-ONE-FOLDER). The folder is
self-contained: its index.html is the front page (the Plugin Studio), <bundle>/ holds each plugin, and
assets/ carries the data, fonts and images the plugins fetch.
ONE build, THREE consumers, all reading THIS folder:
1. Railway / CDN  — serve it statically; partner sites embed from stable URLs
2. Capacitor      — this webDir; `cap sync` copies it into deployment/capacitor/android/app/src/main/assets/public/,
then `bun run app:start-page` makes the UPG-100 list the app's start page
3. local staging  — `bun run serve` (public/ on :4173; open /<tree>/index.html)
⚠️ SOFT FAILURE: a wrong webDir yields an EMPTY assets/public and a BLANK WHITE SCREEN at launch, not an
error. After every sync, verify deployment/capacitor/android/app/src/main/assets/public/index.html exists (`bun run cap:verify`).

//: Capacitor defaults are deliberately kept: iosScheme 'capacitor', androidScheme 'https', hostname
'localhost'. Do NOT set a custom scheme — Capacitor docs warn that as of WebView 117 custom schemes
cannot change the URL path and can break routing. Do NOT set server.url either; that is documented as
CONSEQUENCE FOR US: the app origin is https://localhost, so the doxa.life token endpoint (tokenUrl) must
send CORS headers permitting that origin. This is the single most likely runtime surprise, and the fix is
a response header on doxa.life — not a change here.

android.//: Native project lives in ./capacitor/android and is COMMITTED — `cap add` scaffolds it ONCE, then it is hand-edited source (manifest, icons, versionCode). It sits under deployment/capacitor/ rather than app/ because app/ is the BUNDLE OUTPUT tree: this repo emits several kinds of product, and Capacitor is one facet of them, not the whole. Only app/src/main/assets/public/ is generated and gitignored. An iOS project would join it at deployment/capacitor/ios (ios.path), scaffolded on a Mac.
